name: Pilfered Windstones

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can see how the Highlands Bandits exploit a settlement stretched thin by cultist threats.
As a Skyborne, you know daily life on Zephras depends on windstones. Recovering and defending these caches matters to local settlements.

faq.answer: Residents on Zephras rely on windstones for daily life and survival. Settlements keep reserve caches for emergencies.
faq.q: What are windstones used for on Zephras?

faq.answer: The Highlands Bandits stole the windstones. Captured bandits from a cave in the Shen'dar Highlands were found carrying them, and locals believe the thieves had been breaking into village storehouses for months.
The Highlands Bandits camp in a cave north of the settlement, in the Shen'dar Highlands. They keep goods taken from village stores there.
faq.q: Where are the Highlands Bandits located?

aliases: why not attack the bandit cave
faq.answer: Aonda oversees the settlement's defense and has declined to organize a raid on the northern cave because the village has few peacekeepers. Sending them away would leave the settlement vulnerable to growing cultist numbers at Falaath Village to the south.
faq.q: Why hasn't the village cleared out the bandit cave?

faq.answer: Cultist numbers are growing at Falaath Village, south of the settlement. Their presence keeps the peacekeepers guarding their home instead of pursuing bandits.
faq.q: What is the threat at Falaath Village?

faq.answer: Recovering the stolen stones gives emergency stores temporary relief, but supply route disruptions remain urgent. Without secure supply lines, shortages will continue to threaten the settlement.
faq.q: Does recovering the windstones solve the settlement's shortage?

sections.body: Windstones keep daily life moving on Zephras. Each settlement keeps emergency stores for times of crisis, but village supplies began to run short. Then captured bandits from the northern Shen'dar Highlands were found carrying the stones. For months, the Highlands Bandits had slipped into local stockpiles, taking what they could while security was thin.
sections.title: The Stolen Caches of Zephras

sections.body: Aonda is responsible for village defense, and has refused to approve a raid on the northern cave. The settlement has too few peacekeepers to spare. To the south, cultists are multiplying at Falaath Village, so the guards must hold their posts against that threat. With the peacekeepers pinned down, independent adventurers must face the bandits and recover the stolen windstones.
sections.title: Stretched Defenses and Looming Threats

summary: On Zephras, stolen windstones have left emergency stores short. The Highlands Bandits took them while Aonda's few peacekeepers guard against growing cultist numbers at Falaath Village.
